findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
The knife block in the bakery was observed to have an accumulation of soil residue on the top of it. CORRECTED- The knife block was removed to be cleaned. Ensure that this is being routinely cleaned to keep it clean to sight and touch. 

A cutting board in the produce preparation room was observed to be stored behind the faucet. CORRECTED- This was discussed with the PIC and the cutting board will be washed, rinsed, and sanitized before it is used. Ensure that cutting boards are stored in a manner that does not expose them to contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The sanitizer bucket in the produce preparation cooler room was observed to test at a concentration of 0ppm of Quaternary ammonium. CORRECTED- The employee stated that it was made at around 7am and the sanitizer bucket was remade. The sanitizer bucket tested to be at 400ppm of Quaternary ammonium. Ensure that staff are educated to frequently test sanitizer buckets and remake them if they are not at a label-recommended concentration.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: The following areas are in need of cleaning: 

1. The sprayers in the produce section are observed to have soil residue on them and need cleaned. 
2. There is soil residue on and around the fans in the dairy cooler, as well as on the ceiling of the cooler. 

Ensure that these nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned. 

NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The following physical facilities are observed to be in need of repair: 

1. The grates on the produce sections are beginning to rust. Ensure that these are sealed or replaced to prevent contamination to the produce. 
2. The bakery triple sink’s caulking is beginning to mold. Ensure that this is replaced. 
3. There is duct tape on the floor holding down a mat in front of a walk-in cooler in the bakery. Ensure that duct tape is not used as a repair method on floors, due to it not being smooth and easily cleanable. 

Ensure that physical facilities are maintained in good repair. 

PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
